detail.longDescription: Upgrading the MCP Python SDK does not fix its OAuth credential leak (CVE-2026-115563) for unattended clients. The client-credentials and private-key-JWT providers still follow whatever authorization server the MCP server advertises until you pass issuer=. On mcp 1.30.0, leaving it out emits only a DeprecationWarning, which Python hides by default. https:// github.com/modelcontextprotoco l/python-sdk/security/advisories/GHSA-qx49-fqc8-xw99 # Python # MCP # AIAgents # Cybersecurity
